role: A one-shot, previously unopened public-condition gate for the independently sealed v206 all-nine streaming compact K1 pipeline. Case 5 is external to the PoolFire fit/development data but belongs to the already used BLASTNet vitiated-H2-air family. A pass can establish single-condition all-nine straight-ray matched-accuracy and fresh-process resource headroom; it cannot establish broad external-family generalization, variable-cardinality success, exact-call reduction, curved-ray validity, real BOST, paper success, or an algorithm breakthrough.
scientific_question: Without fitting, adapting, selecting a threshold, or changing the frozen affine representation, tau, geometry, detector integration, CGLS recurrence, metrics, controls, or resource gate, does the v206 streaming compact K1 pipeline preserve the accepted dense K2 reference accuracy on all 42 frames and 13 reported all-nine calibrations of previously unopened BLASTNet Case 5, and if so does it retain its independently sealed wall and whole-pipeline RSS advantage over both dense K1 and dense K2 in fresh processes?

result_before_opening_audit.selection_rule: Use the first still-unopened eligible condition in the v75 projected-density-byte and case-ID ordering after the already consumed Case 3 sentinel and fixed Case 4/6 expansion.

selected_public_dataset.description: BLASTNet vitiated H2-air freely propagating flame DNS Case 5

acquisition_and_opening_contract.download_scope: Only Kaggle info.json, X/Y/Z grids, and all 42 RHO files. Velocity, pressure, temperature, and species files are forbidden.
open_release_must_bind: tracked clean source commit and source closure
all 46 file paths, sizes, and SHA256 values
Kaggle dataset identity, version, listing identity, and signed source-object identities
the observation builder, formal runner, scorer, independent validator, and focused-test hashes
the calibration tree, affine center/basis, metric gates, controls, call ledgers, and decision strings

frozen_preprocessing.source_grid: Read X/Y/Z as little-endian float32 C-order arrays with shape (1408,128,128). Verify rectilinearity, finite strictly monotone axes, and reverse both axis and density dimension if an axis decreases.
frozen_preprocessing.source_density: Read each RHO file as little-endian float32 C-order shape (1408,128,128) and require every value finite. Do not clip, shift, normalize amplitude, register, crop, or track a flame front.
frozen_preprocessing.interpolation: Deterministic float64 trilinear interpolation on endpoint-inclusive float64 linspace coordinates with bounds_error=true and no extrapolation.
frozen_preprocessing.support: Apply the frozen one-voxel outer-boundary zero support.
frozen_preprocessing.gauge: Subtract the supported-interior spatial mean before applying the support mask.

frozen_geometry_and_representation.observation_generation: Generate one noise-free all-nine straight-ray observation per preprocessed field and reported calibration with the exact frozen operator.
frozen_geometry_and_representation.formal_compact_factorization: Per-camera streamed detector-potential blocks accumulated into the affine normal matrix, followed by the frozen packed lower Cholesky solve.
frozen_geometry_and_representation.independent_compact_factorization: A separately coded detector integration and adjoint form the normal matrix, and a symmetric eigensystem solve reconstructs the compact coordinates.

data_isolation_and_prediction_barrier.observation_builder: After the single-use release opens numeric data, a dedicated process may read truth only to preprocess all 42 fields and write exactly 13 finite observation arrays plus a truth manifest. It may not construct a candidate, metric, pass mask, control comparison, or decision.
deployment_prediction_inputs: fixed tau=2^-8 and frozen algorithm constants
deployment_prediction_forbidden_inputs: snapshot ID or time as a feature
Case 5 metric, pass mask, or K2 reference output
data_isolation_and_prediction_barrier.prediction_barrier: The formal prediction process writes every primary and control candidate field, residual, call receipt, and read-set attestation for all 546 cells before a separate scorer may read Case 5 truth.

accuracy_gate.interior_gradient_boundary: The inherited v199/v205/v206 contract did not include a separate interior-gradient metric. v207 therefore cannot establish the long-term interior-gradient requirement.

arms_and_exact_call_ledger.blocking_rule: If any blocking control passes all 546 strict cells and all 13 complete calibration groups, it blocks a representation-specific accuracy-headroom claim.
arms_and_exact_call_ledger.exact_call_reduction_claim: forbidden: dense_full_dct_k1 is output-equivalent with one fewer exact adjoint than streaming_compact_k1
arms_and_exact_call_ledger.observation_generation_ledger: 546 exact forwards are offline simulated-data construction and never candidate deployment calls
arms_and_exact_call_ledger.geometry_cache_ledger: All affine-response, detector-potential, normal-factor, and dense-control setup costs are offline geometry-cache construction and must be separately disclosed from logical online calls and fresh worker setup.

required_accuracy_validity_gates: the Case 5 acquisition, numeric-open receipt, source commit, source closure, calibration tree, affine arrays, and all parent evidence are unchanged
the observation builder writes exactly 13 arrays with 42 rows and no candidate, metric, pass mask, control comparison, or decision
the prediction process never reads Case 5 truth and seals all 6-arm predictions before scoring
the scorer opens truth only after the complete immutable prediction barrier
formal streaming compact K1 fields and residuals agree with dense full-DCT K1 within 1e-8 relative error for every cell
the dense full-DCT K2 reference passes all strict cells and complete calibration groups
the streaming compact K1 primary passes all strict cells and complete calibration groups
camera permutations preserve compact coordinates and fields within 1e-9 relative error

formal and independent implementations separately rebuild preprocessing, forward operators, detector integration, compact coordinates, all controls, CGLS recurrences, metrics, tails, pass masks, and exact-call ledgers
all relevant arrays and diagnostics are finite and all input, prediction, score, and validation trees remain unchanged

fresh_resource_gate_if_accuracy_passes.authorization: Run only after independent accuracy validation passes and no frozen blocking control explains all cells and groups.
fresh_resource_gate_if_accuracy_passes.arm_order: Each serial three-arm block uses one of the six permutations in a deterministic shuffled Latin roster, and every block is complete.

fixed_decision_order: Any acquisition, release, source, parent, isolation, preprocessing, observation, prediction-barrier, finite, shape, geometry, permutation, factor, solve, CGLS, metric, tail, control, call-ledger, seal, or independent-comparison failure makes v207 inconclusive.
If dense full-DCT K2 fails any strict cell or complete group, conclude INCONCLUSIVE_BLASTNET_CASE5_REFERENCE_INADEQUATE_V207 and do not interpret primary accuracy or resources.

If streaming compact K1 fails any strict cell or complete group, conclude FAIL_BLASTNET_CASE5_STREAMING_COMPACT_ACCURACY_V207 and close the current external-condition transfer claim without changing Case 5, tau, representation, CGLS depth, thresholds, or controls.

If primary and reference pass but compact initializer-only, zero-CGLS K1, or zero-CGLS K2 also passes all cells and groups, conclude PASS_CHEAPER_CONTROL_EXPLAINS_BLASTNET_CASE5_V207 and do not run the resource gate.
Only if accuracy passes independently and no blocking control passes may run the frozen fresh-process resource gate.
If any valid wall or RSS resource gate fails, conclude FAIL_BLASTNET_CASE5_STREAMING_COMPACT_RESOURCE_V207 and report the exact failed dimensions.
Only if accuracy, controls, independent recomputation, and every resource gate pass may conclude PASS_BLASTNET_CASE5_STREAMING_COMPACT_EXTERNAL_CONDITION_V207.

Even a full pass establishes only one previously unopened all-nine, noise-free, known-geometry, straight-ray condition. It leaves broad external-family generalization, variable-cardinality success, exact-call reduction, interior-gradient completion, curved-ray validity, real BOST, paper success, and algorithm breakthrough false.
failure_action: Do not substitute Case 2 or Case 12, tune tau, change preprocessing, geometry, detector integration, CGLS depth, metrics, thresholds, controls, factorization, resource repetitions, or resource limits after Case 5 numeric opening. Do not rescue a valid failure with CNN, FNO, UNO, DeepONet, extra exact calls, or GPU training.
